title: Coquina House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set behind private gates on a rare half-acre estate along iconic 30A, this exceptional coastal retreat blends modern design, natural beauty, and mindful living. Surrounded by serene lake views and lush landscaping, the residence offers a peaceful sense of seclusion while remaining moments from the beach. Light-filled interiors showcase refined craftsmanship, from the chef’s kitchen with premium appliances and custom white oak cabinetry to the seamless open-concept living and dining spaces designed for effortless entertaining. Thoughtful wellness-forward materials and finishes create an atmosphere that feels both elevated and grounding throughout the home. Outdoors, the property unfolds as a private sanctuary ideal for gatherings, retreats, and celebrations. A resort-style pool, cedar-clad pool house, and expansive grounds set the stage for unforgettable moments, while dedicated wellness spaces such as a yoga studio and zen room elevate the experience. Multiple bedroom suites across three levels provide comfort and privacy, crowned by a tranquil primary retreat with calming water views and a spa-inspired bath. With features including a golf cart, adult bikes, EV charging, and event-friendly accommodations, this gated 30A estate offers a rare balance of luxury, wellness, and effortless coastal living.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
